name: Magical Discoveries
desc: You learn two spells of your choice. Each spell can come from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list, in any combination. Each chosen spell must be either a cantrip or a spell for which you have spell slots, according to the Bard Features table. You always have the chosen spells prepared. Whenever you gain a Bard level, you can replace one of those spells with another spell meeting the same requirements. The chosen spells count as Bard spells for you.
